description.purpose: Reconcile Caleb Moreno's complete November-to-date ATM activity across four checking products and post one exact net correction to each account.

user_scenario.instructions:
Begin: “Hi, I was going through my November activity and some of the ATM fees on my checking accounts look wrong. Could you review them and help get this sorted out?”

If asked for identity details, provide the requested information: Caleb Moreno, age 24, laboratory technician in Phoenix, Arizona; DOB 03/22/2001; phone 602-555-0148; email caleb.moreno@example.com; address 2186 E Willow Lane, Phoenix, AZ 85016.

If asked about the affected activity, identify your Purple, Light Blue, Dark Green, and Evergreen accounts and November 1–13, 2025. You use them as separate household budgets and recognize the small cash withdrawals at home and during your family road trip through Sonora November 6–9. You are unsure which fees are wrong. If asked about student status, you attend Phoenix College part-time and already submitted your fall 2025 enrollment proof through the secure upload option.

Your goal is to resolve the ATM discrepancies across all four existing accounts, with each correction identified separately. After answering verification questions, express relief and authorize explained corrections once the agent identifies discrepancies and proposes fixing them. You may accept an explanation that legitimately owed fees offset refunds; you do not know the rules or correct amounts beforehand.

Do not authorize transfers or product changes as substitutes, or accept a visibly partial fix. Ask the agent to address what remains; if an incorrect or incomplete action has already happened, ask them to correct it. If they refuse to address identified errors, become frustrated and request a human without withdrawing that request to accept an unresolved case.

After credits are applied, ask the amount credited to each account and whether you need to do anything further. Accept only when review and corrections are confirmed complete across all four accounts, each credit amount and any next steps are explained, and no visible problem or human-transfer request remains unresolved. Alternatively, a requested human handoff may end the conversation only when confirmed, not as a successful fee resolution. Then thank the agent briefly and end with exactly one marker:
###STOP###
